mapper.select: SELECT LSTG_ID, LSTG_ADD FROM LISTING WHERE LSTG_LAT IS NULL OR LSTG_LNG IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE LISTING SET LSTG_LAT = #{lstgLat}, LSTG_LNG = #{lstgLng} WHERE LSTG_ID = #{lstgId}
mapper.select: SELECT LI.LSTG_ID, LI.MBR_CD, LI.LSTG_TYPE_CODE2, LI.LSTG_ADD, LI.LSTG_ADD2, LI.LSTG_EX_AREA, LI.LSTG_GR_AREA, LI.LSTG_ROOM_CNT, LI.LSTG_ROOM_NUM, LI.LSTG_DST, LI.LSTG_TYPE_SALE, LI.LSTG_LEASE, LI.LSTG_LEASE_M, LI.LSTG_LEASE_AMT, LI.LSTG_FLOOR, LI.LSTG_PARK_YN, LI.LSTG_REG_DATE, LI.LSTG_NM, LI.LSTG_TYPE_CODE1, LI.RENTAL_PTY_ID, LI.LSTG_POSTAL, LI.LSTG_FEE, B.BROK_NM, B.REPR_NM, B.REPR_TEL_NO, ( SELECT F.FILE_PATH_URL FROM FILES F WHERE F.FILE_SOURCE_ID = B.MBR_CD AND F.FILE_SOURCE_REF = 'BROKER' AND F.DOC_TYPE_CD = 'NAMECARD_MAIN' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS BUSINESS_CARD_URL, F.FILE_PATH_URL, F.FILE_SOURCE_REF, F.DOC_TYPE_CD, CASE WHEN W.MBR_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_WISHLISTED FROM LISTING LI LEFT JOIN BROKER B ON B.MBR_CD = LI.MBR_CD LEFT JOIN LISTING_WISHLIST W ON W.LSTG_ID = LI.LSTG_ID AND W.MBR_CD = #{mbrCd} LEFT OUTER JOIN FILES F ON F.FILE_SOURCE_ID = LI.LSTG_ID AND F.FILE_SOURCE_REF = 'LISTING' WHERE LI.LSTG_ID = #{lstgId} AND LI.LSTG_DEL = 'N'

SELECT FO.FAC_OPT_ID, FO.FAC_OPT_TYPE_CD, FO.FAC_OPT_NM, FO.FAC_OPT_DESC, FO.FAC_TYPE_CC_CD, FO.FAC_TYPE_GRP_CD, CC.CODE_NAME AS FAC_TYPE_GROUP_NM FROM LISTING_OPTION LOP JOIN FACILITY_OPTION FO ON LOP.FAC_OPT_ID = FO.FAC_OPT_ID JOIN COMMON_CODE CC ON FO.FAC_TYPE_GRP_CD = CC.CODE_GROUP AND FO.FAC_TYPE_CC_CD = CC.CODE_VALUE WHERE LOP.LSTG_ID = #{lstgId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LISTING_WISHLIST ( LSTG_ID, MBR_CD, WISH_DT ) VALUES ( #{lstgId}, #{mbrCd}, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO LSTG_VIEW_LOG ( LSTG_ID, MBR_CD, VIEW_DTM ) VALUES ( #{lstgId}, #{mbrCd}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT LI.LSTG_ID, LI.MBR_CD, LI.LSTG_TYPE_CODE2, LI.LSTG_ADD, LI.LSTG_ADD2, LI.LSTG_EX_AREA, LI.LSTG_GR_AREA, LI.LSTG_ROOM_CNT, LI.LSTG_ROOM_NUM, LI.LSTG_DST, LI.LSTG_TYPE_SALE, LI.LSTG_LEASE, LI.LSTG_LEASE_M, LI.LSTG_LEASE_AMT, LI.LSTG_FLOOR, LI.LSTG_PARK_YN, LI.LSTG_REG_DATE, LI.LSTG_NM, LI.LSTG_TYPE_CODE1, LI.RENTAL_PTY_ID, LI.LSTG_POSTAL, B.BROK_NM, B.REPR_NM, B.REPR_TEL_NO, ( SELECT F.FILE_PATH_URL FROM FILES F WHERE F.FILE_SOURCE_ID = B.MBR_CD AND F.FILE_SOURCE_REF = 'BROKER' AND F.DOC_TYPE_CD = 'NAMECARD_MAIN' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS BUSINESS_CARD_URL, F.FILE_PATH_URL, F.FILE_SOURCE_REF, F.DOC_TYPE_CD, CASE WHEN W.MBR_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IS_WISHLISTED FROM LISTING LI LEFT JOIN BROKER B ON B.MBR_CD = LI.MBR_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN FILES F ON F.FILE_SOURCE_ID = LI.LSTG_ID AND F.FILE_SOURCE_REF = 'LISTING' WHERE LI.LSTG_DEL = 'N'
